scope: Independent source-bound implementation-admission checks only; no scientific execution or launch claim.

unique_final_case_outcomes.basis: The first invocation executed all 37 cases. One intended pipeline-stop case used an incomplete mock fixture and was corrected without changing producer code; its one targeted rerun then reached the intended path and failed because all 96 mock cells executed. The other 36 case bodies were unchanged and were not rerun.

commands.exit_semantics: Nonzero because source-bound admission obligations failed; this is an implementation review result, not an experiment failure.

commands.command: /usr/bin/time -p python3 -B -c '<load final checks.py and execute case_pipeline_stops_after_first_invalid_cell once>'
commands.result: AssertionError: named control/certificate invalidity did not stop the panel; 96 mock cells executed

substantive_failed_cases.name: subgroup_enumeration_uses_frozen_repeated_addition
substantive_failed_cases.detail: subgroup_points recomputes every multiple with curve.scalar(scalar, generator), rather than enumerating the certified subgroup by the frozen repeated-addition rule.

substantive_failed_cases.name: all_sixteen_seed_streams_are_executable
substantive_failed_cases.detail: run_future_pipeline loops only over HELDOUT_SEEDS 606308..606315; there is no executable exploratory 606300..606307 stream despite the frozen sixteen-seed contract.

substantive_failed_cases.name: pipeline_stops_after_first_invalid_cell
substantive_failed_cases.detail: After the corrected targeted mock reached the intended path, future_cell returned a failed validity record on its first cell and run_future_pipeline still executed all 96 mock cells instead of applying the frozen stop-on-control-or-certificate-failure rule.

substantive_failed_cases.name: complete_diagnostic_custody
substantive_failed_cases.detail: Canonical output omits scalar inversion/comparison counts, per-diagnostic wall/CPU, collision-table memory, mean first-repeat, useful fraction, fixed/two-cycle counts, component sizes, and maximum tail/cycle lengths.

substantive_failed_cases.name: manifest_utc_interval_matches_measured_wall
substantive_failed_cases.detail: With a fixed 10-second ResourceMeter age, manifest UTC start/finish differed by 0.000007 seconds while measured wall was 10.000025 seconds; both UTC values are sampled at artifact creation.

substantive_failed_cases.name: postrename_fsync_failure_leaves_no_final_directory
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A fixed failure at the first directory fsync after os.rename produced InfrastructureStop but left runs/RUN-ECDLP-deadbe exposed as a complete-looking canonical final directory.

substantive_failed_cases.name: archive_head_can_admit_report_bound_to_source_snapshot
substantive_failed_cases.detail: In a two-commit synthetic Git history, executing at the reachable review archive HEAD caused the driver to require the report source_snapshot_commit to equal the archive commit, rejecting the producer snapshot it actually reviewed.

substantive_failed_cases.name: source_head_can_reach_the_review_archive
substantive_failed_cases.detail: In the same history, executing at the producer snapshot allowed the report source binding but necessarily made the later review archive unreachable from HEAD. Together the two cases show the full launch admission ancestry/source equality is unsatisfiable for an ordinarily archived review.

substantive_failed_cases.name: cayley_dense_work_has_bounded_cancellation_checks
substantive_failed_cases.detail: cayley_weights has no guard callback; dense matrix allocation and some row/column and matrix-vector reductions execute between checkpoints, so cancellation and process-group RSS are not checked throughout every long control loop.

non_substantive_failed_attempt.name: pipeline_stops_after_first_invalid_cell
non_substantive_failed_attempt.detail: The first invocation's mock fixture lacked p and B, so the outer loop raised before fake future_cell and reported zero calls. This was a review-check fixture defect, not producer evidence. It was corrected and the one targeted rerun above supplies the finding.

source_location_handling.reason: A disjoint upstream merge changed the live validator and dispatcher after the review plan was committed.
source_location_handling.handling: The two utilities were read and hash-verified from review-plan commit baefa00db9140147c9cbf11e239310bd299c37d3. No changed live utility bytes were treated as review evidence.

interpretation: The passing cases support exact source custody, corrected RNG, coefficient/cost arithmetic, pooled availability, complete-panel decision controls, validity reduction, basic manifest companions, fail-closed missing authority, and ordinary atomic success only. The failed cases require implementation correction before source-bound measurement admission. They assert nothing about H-ECDLP-3a1c90, the spectral proposal, ECDLP security, or any launch outcome.
